name: Response Mode 2 Code
definition: Message response awaited by the initiator of the Request.

SEND.name: End Of Play
SEND.definition: The Response is required at the end of play.

IMMD.name: Immediate
IMMD.definition: The Message Response is immediate, after taking into account the request.

NREQ.name: Not Required
NREQ.definition: The Message Response is not required, except in case of error.

PEND.name: Print End
PEND.definition: The Print Response is required at the end of print.
